I investigated the life expectancy at birth in Russia for the year 2023. Based on data from the World Bank, Our World in Data, and Macrotrends, the life expectancy at birth in Russia for 2023 was 73.25 years. This figure is consistent across multiple major international databases and represents a slight increase from the previous year.

Answer: 73.25 years
